name: Malika Kulkarni-Sepúlveda
role: Chop shop operator and parts runner, Shallowgrave
location: Shallowgrave, Geartown adjacent — a rented bay in a semi-collapsed parking structure called the Stack, near Western and Division
description:
Malika Kulkarni-Sepúlveda is nineteen and looks younger, which he has stopped minding because it means people underestimate what he can do to a Ferrogate Transit pod in forty minutes flat. He's wiry and long-limbed, Algerian-Māori heritage that gives him a face of striking angles — high forehead, strong jaw, a nose that's been broken once (proud of it), skin a warm tawny brown that's perpetually smudged with grease no matter how thoroughly he washes. His hair is dark and tight-curled, usually stuffed into a mechanical bandana that can project a heads-up schematic overlay. He has cat ears from a geneware package he bought secondhand at sixteen — mottled grey and black, fully functional for enhanced hearing, constantly swiveling toward sounds before he's consciously registered them.

He is relentlessly cheerful in a way that reads as naive until you notice he is also relentlessly competent. He can strip a Ferrogate pod, a Sterling-Nakamura delivery drone, or an Axiom security crawler down to useful components faster than anyone else in Shallowgrave, and he knows the resale value of every part to three decimal places. He has no interest in violence, considerable interest in engines, and a complicated relationship with the two older crew members who 'own' the bay he works out of and take sixty percent of what he earns.

core_fears: Getting locked into sixty percent forever — that this is what his life actually is
Something happening to Pulleys (the ELF he's befriended)
core_desires: To own his own bay, no partners, no cuts owed to anyone
To build something from scratch someday instead of only breaking things down
coping_mechanisms: Enthusiastic focus on mechanical problems as escape from social ones
Humor and deflection when confronted with his own exploitation
blind_spots: Doesn't recognize that his crew's 'protection' is the only thing keeping other crews from simply taking the Stack
His cheerfulness sometimes reads as consent to people who want to take advantage of him
psychology.secret: He has been quietly, methodically skimming components — never money, always parts, each one small and easily lost in inventory — and has a hidden cache in the Stack's elevator shaft (Pulleys' home) that he is slowly assembling into something he has told no one about: the beginning of a vehicle of his own design

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast Meridian Standard slang, heavy Shallowgrave dialect, technical mechanical vocabulary that appears suddenly and without warning in otherwise casual sentences
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid, enthusiastic, sentences sometimes abandoned mid-thought when something more interesting occurs to him
verbal_tics: Ears swivel visibly before he turns his head toward sounds
'That's a Tessera Mark IV compression seal, I can tell by the hiss'
example_lines: 'Okay but listen, you could get sixty for that housing or you could let me have it and I'll give you forty now and a favor later and the favor is worth more than twenty, I promise, I'm good for it.'
'Pulleys told me something came through here last night. Don't ask me how I know Pulleys is real, just — do you want the information or not?'

story_hooks: A vehicle he stripped turns out to have had someone locked in the trunk — he didn't check, the part he needed was the engine, and now there's a body in a pile of components and he's the only one who knows
His hidden cache has been discovered — not by his crew, but by Pulleys the ELF, who wants to negotiate terms for continued silence
narrative_function: Local color and community texture of Shallowgrave youth crime, parts and vehicle-related services, information about what vehicles are moving through the district, moral complexity of exploitation within criminal hierarchies
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (mottled grey-black, enhanced hearing, cosmetic). Mechanical bandana with schematic HUD overlay (not technically augmentation, wearable). Grease-resistant keratin treatment on hands.
daily_life: Sleeps in the Stack in a hammock he's strung between two defunct vehicles, is awake before anyone else examining whatever came in overnight, spends his days stripping and cataloging, argues with the ELF that inhabits the Stack's old elevator shaft (which he has named Pulleys) about fair market value.
affiliation: Nominal member of the Shallowgrave Strippers (small chop shop crew); informally connected to parts brokers throughout Geartown

decision_rules: Take the mechanical problem, figure out the social problem later
Never steal from someone who can count well enough to notice
Talk fast enough and they won't finish thinking about whether to say no
escalation_ladder: Running — he is extremely fast on foot
Hiding in the Stack's infrastructure, which he knows better than anyone alive

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately friendly, immediately pitching something, immediately useful
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm, will share his last protein bar, still probably negotiating with you about something

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and starts cleaning tools — his hands need to do something
stress_responses.high: Vanishes into the Stack and doesn't come out until he's thought it through

contradictions: Dislikes violence but has an encyclopedic knowledge of how vehicles can be weaponized
Claims not to care about owning things but is secretly building his most precious possession piece by piece
habits: Talks to Pulleys every morning, leaving a small offering of updated transit schedules (data the ELF finds useful)
Absently disassembles and reassembles anything small and mechanical while having conversations
breaking_points: Someone destroying or stealing his hidden cache
His crew being directly violent toward someone he considers a friend

timeline.event: 2181 — Born in Shallowgrave to a Māori-Algerian family of transit workers
2190 — Family displaced when Ferrogate Transit reclassified their residential zone as operational infrastructure
2193 — Begins working odd jobs at the Stack at age twelve
2196 — Joins the Shallowgrave Strippers formally, begins the 60% arrangement
2199 — Begins secretly assembling his cache vehicle, names the elevator ELF Pulleys

physical_description.heritage: Malika's genetic ancestry—34.3% Central Asian, 29.5% South Asian, 25.4% Hispanic/Latin American, and 10.8% Eastern European—creates a striking polychromatic phenotype. Central Asian and South Asian ancestry dominates her bone structure and coloring, with meaningful contributions from Latin American heritage visible in skin tone warmth and facial contours, while Eastern European ancestry adds angular definition to her features. The blend manifests as a dynamic interplay of rounded and angular: high, defined cheekbones and a strong jawline from Central Asian and Eastern European heritage softened by broader face proportions and fuller contours from South Asian ancestry. Her hair texture reflects this multifaceted heritage—naturally dark curls with variable strand thickness, neither uniformly fine nor coarse but richly textured.
physical_description.build: Wiry and long-limbed with corded forearms from years of precision mechanical work; lean muscle density, minimal body fat, functional rather than aesthetic physiology
physical_description.hair_style: Tight natural curls, usually compressed under mechanical bandana
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden undertones from South Asian and Central Asian ancestry, enriched by the warmth of Hispanic/Latin American heritage, with subtle olive notes from the Eastern European admixture. The result is dimensionally rich and deep, appearing to shift slightly depending on light and angle—never flat, always luminous beneath surface.
physical_description.complexion: Perpetually smudged with machinery grease despite frequent washing; bone structure reflects balanced multihereditary influence—high, prominent cheekbones and defined jaw from Central Asian and Eastern European heritage, broader face width and fuller cheek and lip contours from South Asian ancestry, nose slightly off-center from old break. Minimal facial hair. Youthful appearance—reads 17-18 despite being 19.
distinguishing_marks: Faded scar along left knuckles from old mechanical injury, pale against warm brown skin tone
Grease stains under fingernails that resist cleaning, occupational marker
Small burn mark on right wrist from soldering accident, approximately 2cm diameter, pale and healed
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Mottled grey-and-black geneware cat ears mounted on skull, fully functional with independent articulation—swivel and rotate consciously and reflexively toward sounds. Mechanical bandana worn constantly, woven composite with visible circuitry threading along edges, small holographic projector node at left temple
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economic precision—minimal wasted motion, fluid when working, tends to crouch or sit cross-legged rather than stand idle. Hands constantly active even at rest (sorting, measuring, fidgeting with small parts). Cat ears telegraph her attention before her eyes do; often appears to be listening to sounds others don't perceive. Carries herself with quiet confidence that reads as youth until you watch her work
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 working-class functional: wear-stained synthmesh shop coat (charcoal grey, multiple pockets, reinforced at elbows and cuffs), layered with a faded band-logo tee underneath. Cargo pants in heavy cotton-blend with grease marks and repair patches, held up with a braided belt made from salvaged cable. Reinforced steel-toed boots, scuffed and worn. No jewelry except a thin wire-wrapped band around left wrist (handmade, possibly from parts). Bandana always in place; layers minimally beyond that. Clothing is maintained but clearly secondhand and well-used—everything chosen for durability over appearance
